 LIVE – Arsenal v Everton: Commentary, updates, goals and stats
 Arsenal host Everton this afternoon looking to claim another three points in their quest to retain the title. Follow all the action from the Emirates with our live commentary...
 Jon Fisher 
 • 
 Last Update:
 23rd October 2026
 • 
 2 min read
 Arsenal will look to beat Everton on Saturday afternoon and remain on the coat-tails of Premier League leaders Manchester City.
 The Gunners have bounced back well from defeat at Brighton before the international break with wins over Leeds, Lille and Nottingham Forest before the 2-2 draw at Bayern Munich in midweek.
 Everton arrive in North London after a disappointing afternoon against Chelsea at the Hill Dickinson Stadium, where Pedro Neto scored twice for the visitors in a 2-0 victory. David Moyes’s side are eighth, three points off the top four, and they have been very hard to beat on the road, drawing all three of their away league games. 
 They are one of only four teams still unbeaten away from home in the Premier League this season.
 Where to Watch Arsenal v Everton: TV and online streams
 Arsenal versus Everton kicks off at 3pm BST on Saturday, October 24 at the Emirates Stadium.
 As a Saturday 3pm kick-off, the match is not being shown live on TV in the UK because of the blackout rules. Highlights will be on Match of the Day on Saturday night. In the US, it’s live on NBC Sports and Peacock at 10am ET.
 Global broadcast details can be found at  premierleague.com .
 Recent Form & Stats for Arsenal v Everton
 Arsenal have won all three Premier League games at the Emirates this season
 Arsenal have won their last six games at the Emirates in all competitions
 Everton are winless in seven against the Gunners
 Arsenal won the corresponding fixture last season 2-0 with Max Dowman’s effort making him the youngest goalscorer in Premier League history
